completion_criteria.camera_stable: The camera viewpoint remains fixed throughout the transition.
completion_criteria.cube_elevated: The cube is visibly above the tray surface with a clear air gap between the cube and the tray.
completion_criteria.right_gripper_involved: The cube's lifted state is caused by or associated with the right gripper, such as being held by the gripper or directly lifted by it.
completion_criteria.tray_relation_changed: The cube is no longer supported by or sitting on the tray.

failure_modes: Cube remains on the tray with no clear vertical lift.
Cube moves laterally but is not raised above the tray.
Cube is lifted by the wrong gripper or by an unexplained force unrelated to the right gripper.
Tray moves, tilts, or disappears as part of the action.
Camera pans, zooms, cuts, or changes perspective.
Unrelated scene anchors shift, deform, appear, or disappear.
Cube changes appearance or becomes a different object.
Right gripper moves without successfully lifting the cube.

initial_state.camera: fixed third-person view of the robot lab workspace
initial_state.cube: resting on the floor of the blue tray near the tray center
initial_state.right_gripper: positioned above and near the cube, open or ready to grasp
initial_state.tray: blue tray stationary on the tabletop

intended_change.description: The right gripper should grasp or otherwise lift the cube upward so the cube is suspended above the blue tray rather than resting on it.
intended_change.state_delta: cube vertical position increases from tray contact/support to clearly elevated above the tray, with the right gripper acting as the lifting agent

negative_constraints: Do not move the camera or change viewpoint.
Do not move the tray as the primary action.
Do not slide the cube sideways off the tray instead of lifting it.
Do not lift the cube with the left gripper.
Do not introduce new objects or remove existing scene anchors.
Do not alter unrelated robot parts, tabletop objects, or background elements beyond what is necessary for the right gripper to lift the cube.
Do not change the cube's identity, size, material, or color.
protected_anchors: blue tray position, orientation, and appearance
left robot arm and left gripper pose except for incidental unchanged presence
right robot arm base and nonessential scene geometry
green cutting mat on the left
background benches, windows, cabinets, and lab objects

target.relation: vertical position relative to the blue tray
